title: Altered AP-1, RUNX and EGR chromatin dynamics drive fibrotic lung disease.
authors: Valenzi, Eleanor; Jia, Minxue; Gerges, Peter; Fan, Jingyu; Tabib, Tracy; Behara, Rithika; Zhou, Yuechen; Sembrat, John; Das, Jishnu; Benos, Panayiotis V; Singh, Harinder; Lafyatis, Robert
journal: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
one_liner_zh: 该文利用多组学数据和神经网络工具推断肺纤维化中AP-1、RUNX和EGR转录因子在染色质上的结合活性，虽聚焦TF-DNA结合位点推断，但主要基于序列和染色质数据，缺乏三维互作建模或物理模拟，方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: Pulmonary fibrosis, including systemic sclerosis-associated interstitial lung disease (SSc-ILD), involves myofibroblasts and SPP1(hi) macrophages as drivers of fibrosis. Single-cell RNA sequencing has delineated fibroblast and macrophages transcriptomes, but limited insight into transcriptional control of profibrotic gene programs. To address this challenge, we analyzed multiomic snATAC/snRNA-seq on explanted SSc-ILD and donor control lungs. The neural network tool ChromBPNet inferred increased TF binding at single base pair resolution to profibrotic genes, including CTHRC1 and ADAM12, in fibroblasts and SPP1 and CCL18 in macrophages. The novel algorithm HALO confirmed AP-1, RUNX, and EGR TF activity controlling profibrotic gene programs and established TF-regulatory element-gene networks. This TF action atlas provides comprehensive insights into the transcriptional regulation of fibroblasts and macrophages in healthy and fibrotic human lungs.
abstract_zh: 肺纤维化，包括系统性硬化症相关间质性肺病（SSc-ILD），涉及肌成纤维细胞和SPP1(hi)巨噬细胞作为纤维化的驱动因素。单细胞RNA测序已描绘了成纤维细胞和巨噬细胞的转录组，但对促纤维化基因程序的转录控制了解有限。为应对这一挑战，我们分析了外植的SSc-ILD和供体对照肺的多组学snATAC/snRNA-seq数据。神经网络工具ChromBPNet推断出在成纤维细胞中促纤维化基因（包括CTHRC1和ADAM12）以及巨噬细胞中SPP1和CCL18的转录因子结合增加，分辨率达到单碱基对水平。新算法HALO确认了AP-1、RUNX和EGR转录因子活性控制促纤维化基因程序，并建立了转录因子-调控元件-基因网络。该转录因子作用图谱为健康和纤维化人肺中成纤维细胞和巨噬细胞的转录调控提供了全面见解。
